lede: The San Miguel County Planning Commission takes up three Land Use Code amendments Thursday — covering forestry, oil and gas, and geothermal energy — and their recommendations will shape what goes to the BOCC, so that's the one to watch this week. Also on Thursday, the SMART board votes on hiring an investment advisor and accepting the FY25 audit. Later in the week, HARC holds a work session on a potential demolition and rebuild of Rebekah Hall, the town-owned building where they actually meet, and the county's Housing Code Update working group digs into workforce housing provisions funded through Proposition 123.

notable.stake: Commission recommends on code changes covering forestry, oil/gas, and geothermal.
